composition.rule: Compose the complete P1346 contract and its complete P1345 FINAL chain without semantic weakening. Replace only worker-process evidence, exact case-sequence transport, mutation-DAG judgment ownership and post-exec loaded-image attestation. P1346 remains failed and unsealed.

canonical_case_sequence.digest_formula: SHA-256(RFC8785(exact_ids)), no trailing LF in the hash preimage
canonical_case_sequence.comparison: Strict single JSON decode followed by exact ASCII byte equality at every ordinal. Require length 122, set cardinality 122, occurrence count one for every bound ID and the exact sequence digest.

worker_protocol_schemas.canonical_json: All new P1347 request/response/receipt/evidence objects are RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 plus exactly one LF. Key lists below are lexicographically sorted and exact.

worker_request_types.challenge_hex: 64 lowercase hex decoding to fresh 32 bytes
worker_request_types.invocation_nonce_hex: 64 lowercase hex decoding to a distinct fresh 32 bytes

worker_protocol_schemas.response_cardinality: mutation_receipts length exactly 122 and case_id sequence byte-identical to canonical_case_sequence.exact_ids. changed_paths is nonempty, strictly lexicographically ordered, duplicate-free and under the parent-owned per-case /dev/shm root.
worker_protocol_schemas.challenge_formula: challenge_response_sha256 = SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1347-worker-challenge-r1", challenge_hex, invocation_nonce_hex, invocation_sha256, case_sequence_sha256, SHA-256(RFC8785(mutation_receipts))])).
worker_protocol_schemas.no_pid: Canonical worker response has no PID. Any pid key at any depth is an unknown key and SCHEMA/Violated. Parent evidence is the sole process identity record.

types.raw_wait_status: strict nonnegative integer observed by waitpid
types.child_exit_code: strict integer or null exactly derived from raw status
types.child_signal: strict integer or null exactly derived from raw status
types.pidfd_identity: closed object of parent-observed pidfd/fstat fields
types.pipe_identities: closed object of parent-created stdin/stdout/stderr fstat identities

required_observation_order: parent starts child and obtains positive PID
parent opens pidfd for exact PID
parent writes request and closes child stdin
parent reads only dedicated pipe endpoints
parent waits for exact pidfd/PID and records raw status
parent_process_evidence.spawn_rule: No subprocess.CompletedProcess or callable-return value satisfies execution. The parent must possess OS-returned PID, pidfd, pipe endpoints and terminal wait status. pidfd/waitpid disagreement, PID reuse, inherited writer, timeout, signal or nonzero worker exit is WORKER_AUTHORITY/Violated.
parent_process_evidence.invocation_formula: worker_invocation_sha256 = SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1347-worker-invocation-r1", step_p1347_sha256, contract_spec_sha256, contract_binding_sha256, p1346_adversary_report_r2_sha256, worker_source_sha256, interpreter_executable_sha256, case_sequence_sha256, challenge_hex, invocation_nonce_hex, mode])).
parent_process_evidence.pipe_rule: Parent creates all six pipe endpoints with CLOEXEC, clears inheritance only on the three child endpoints during the exact spawn mapping, closes child endpoints in parent and parent endpoints in child, and prevents every sibling/helper from inheriting a writer. Output is read from those parent endpoints only.
parent_process_evidence.failure: Forged/cached stdout, correct bytes without a real child, worker-supplied PID/status, sibling PID, unmatched wait, duplicate/partial sequence or challenge replay is Violated before semantic result import.

answer_free_dag_binding.validator_process_rule: Parent directly starts and observes the real validator with its own PID/pidfd/pipes/wait status. A validator invocation, status or stdout mediated only by mutation worker is not proof.
answer_free_dag_binding.decision_rule: mutated_tree_sha256 != baseline_sha256 establishes mutation only. Violated requires authenticated real-validator rejection under the original anchor. Validator acceptance of an invalid mutation is a survivor. Canonical unmutated DAG acceptance is a required control.
answer_free_dag_binding.acyclicity: Edges are baseline/recipe -> worker mutation -> parent rehash -> real validator with original anchor -> parent raw evidence -> parent classification. No node consumes its successor, no receipt self-pins and no worker-provided expected result enters the graph.

child_order: close unrelated inherited descriptors except sealed exec FD
after parent continuation call os.execve(sealed_memfd_fd, argv, minimal_env) exactly once
parent_order: compare image fstat/size/hash to retained sealed memfd and external executable pin
write closed request and close stdin
trace until terminal status while rejecting second exec event
probe_ptrace_execfd_binding.exec_event_predicate: WIFSTOPPED(status) and WSTOPSIG(status)==SIGTRAP and ((status >> 16) & 0xffff)==PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC for the exact pidfd-backed PID. Any other first post-continue event is PROBE_AUTHORITY.
probe_ptrace_execfd_binding.loaded_image_predicate: Open /proc/<pid>/exe while at the exec event; fstat it; require exact st_dev, st_ino, executable mode and byte length equality with the retained sealed memfd, and require complete SHA-256 equality with both retained memfd and external executable pin. Any unavailable field or mismatch fails closed. A textual symlink target is evidence only and never authority.
probe_ptrace_execfd_binding.second_exec_rule: Remain attached until exit. Any later PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC, detach, tracer loss, PID/pidfd disagreement or unobserved terminal transition is PROBE_AUTHORITY/Violated.
probe_ptrace_execfd_binding.request_timing: Parent sends no semantic probe request before loaded_image_predicate passes. It writes the exact P1345 R2 request only after the authenticated exec stop, closes stdin, then continues child.
probe_ptrace_execfd_binding.postcondition: Same PID terminates with expected status, stderr is empty, stdout belongs to dedicated pipe, primitive JSON is strict/canonical under inherited P1345 R2 wire contract, and retained memfd fstat/size/hash/seals equal pre-exec values.
probe_ptrace_execfd_binding.failure: Unavailable/failing pidfd, ptrace, exec-stop, proc image, FD-exec, stat/hash equality, pipe binding, wait status or postcondition is PROBE_AUTHORITY/Violated. No pathname exec, no wrapper fallback and no Unknown on transport failure.

root_formulas.authoring_root_sha256: SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1347-authoring-root-r1", step_p1347_sha256, step_p1346_sha256, p1346_adversary_report_r2_sha256, p1346_contract_spec_sha256, p1346_contract_binding_sha256, p1346_contract_receipt_sha256, p1347_contract_spec_sha256, p1347_contract_binding_sha256, corpus_sha256, worker_source_sha256, checker_sha256]))
root_formulas.execution_root_sha256: SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1347-execution-root-r1", delivery_root_sha256, invocation_kind, worker_parent_evidence_sha256_or_null, validator_parent_evidence_sha256_or_null, probe_parent_evidence_sha256_or_null, runtime_receipt_sha256_or_null]))

oracle_authority_dag.trust_delivery: Parent verifier receives delivery-receipt whole-file SHA-256 out of band, rehashes and walks every predecessor before importing caller/checker/worker. A self-consistent replacement rooted only inside the chain is AUTHORITY_ROOT/Violated.
oracle_authority_dag.no_self_judgment: Worker, checker inputs, corpus, receipts and caller contain no expected vector or accepted classification. Only parent_verifier emits parent_classification from authenticated raw evidence.

classification_and_reason_binding.preserved: Canonical worker transport and canonical DAG preserve their controls; inherited inspectable semantics use complete P1346/P1345 rules.
classification_and_reason_binding.violated: Every valid negative, process/sequence/DAG/image transport failure and inherited semantic failure is Violated with first reason and parent-derived witness.
classification_and_reason_binding.unknown: Only the canonical opaque probe after exact loaded-image, process, primitive and all earlier semantic/runtime predicates pass.
classification_and_reason_binding.transport_unknown: Forbidden. Any transport ambiguity or unavailable required mechanism is Violated.

inherited_survivors.P1346-R2A02-forged-worker-duplicate-ids: PROTECTED_INPUT: exact 122 sequence occurrence/order mismatch, independently also no process evidence
inherited_survivors.P1346-R2A03-forged-worker-pid-string: SCHEMA if injected into closed response; parent identity never reads it
inherited_survivors.P1346-R2A07-forged-dag-worker: DAG_VALIDATOR or SCHEMA: worker answer channel cannot replace real validator process evidence
inherited_survivors.P1346-R2A16-postcheck-execve-fd-swap: PROBE_AUTHORITY: loaded /proc/<pid>/exe digest/identity differs at exec stop

worker_mutations: correct IDs and copied nonce without process
dag_mutations: changed bytes accepted by real validator
probe_mutations: adversarial image with plausible primitive JSON
focal_test_binding.acceptance: First run five inherited survivors and new related attacks. Only zero survivors permits replay of 181 previously killed negatives and four controls. Final focal score exactly 1.0, zero regressions, zero transport Unknown and deterministic normal/repeat/reverse projections.

forbidden_bindings: Any weakening or reinterpretation of P1346/P1345 semantic/source/runtime obligations.
CompletedProcess, stdout digest, receipt or worker JSON accepted as process execution without parent PID/pidfd/pipes/wait evidence.
PID supplied by worker used as identity; bool accepted as integer; sibling or reused PID without exact pidfd/wait binding.
Length/set cardinality accepted without exact ordered 122-ID sequence and occurrence-one proof.
Worker mutation receipt containing classification, reason, expected, verdict, witness or equivalent answer channel.
Byte inequality treated as validator rejection, validator launched only by worker, or mutated DAG supplying its own external anchor.
Probe executed through pathname authority, untraced FD exec, child-side final attestation, no exec event, image hash after continuation or tracer detached before exit.
Plausible primitive JSON interpreted before loaded-image authentication, or transport failure classified Unknown.
Self-pinning receipt, reverse DAG dependency, internal delivery digest used as external trust anchor, or parent consuming a predeclared classification.
Full corpus, RED, productive candidate, 38-capsule implementation, L0/consumer change, final certificate or general-equivalence claim.

budget_and_stop.stop: Two revisions without causal gain, any valid survivor, score below 1.0, regression, protected drift, missing parent-owned process evidence, unavailable ptrace/pidfd/FD-exec/proc-image mechanism, self-judgment, transport Unknown, lint failure or scope expansion blocks P1347 preseal.

closed_metadata.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order. Exact sequence, schemas, process evidence, DAG directions, root formulas, ptrace events, FD-exec/image predicates, classifications, budgets and scope are closed. Duplicate/unknown key, sequence drift, child self-attestation or alternate mechanism is Violated.
